subject.title: fix embedded compaction hook reset API

question: Should external after-compaction hooks receive a permanent current-session reset capability, and must that capability be unavailable to every other hook phase?
rationale: This changes the public plugin contract and grants hooks a new session-state mutation; code review cannot choose the intended long-term capability boundary.

options.title: Compaction-only API
options.body: Expose a dedicated reset capability only to `after_compaction`, coalesce requests, and document its deferred lifecycle semantics.

options.title: General hook API
options.body: Approve reset as a broader hook-context capability and explicitly define supported phases, authorization, deduplication, and lifecycle behavior.

options.title: Keep resets gateway-owned
options.body: Decline the plugin API and retain reset operations behind existing user and Gateway-owned flows.

recommendation.title: Compaction-only API
recommendation.body: Expose a dedicated reset capability only to `after_compaction`, coalesce requests, and document its deferred lifecycle semantics.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent compaction hook and harness-parity history makes Vincent the strongest available routing candidate for the cross-runtime contract decision.
